# Multi-Agent Workflow Status Flows

## Standard Workflow Status Lifecycle

All workflows follow the same controlled status lifecycle:

Created

\-\> Assigned

\-\> Acknowledged

\-\> In Progress

\-\> Waiting for Information

\-\> Responded

\-\> Resolved

\-\> Closed

## Exception and Escalation Lifecycle

When a task, request, approval, or follow-up is not completed within the defined SLA:

In Progress

\-\> Overdue

\-\> Escalated

\-\> Resolved / Rejected / Reassigned

\-\> Closed

> `Rejected` is an exception outcome and should not be treated as a mandatory step in every successful workflow.

# 1\. Client Query to BD Workflow

## Forward Flow

Client Query Created

\-\> Assigned to BD Agent

\-\> Acknowledged by BD Agent

\-\> In Progress: Query Reviewed and Categorized

\-\> Waiting for Information: Missing Client Details Requested

\-\> Responded: Client Provides Required Information

\-\> Resolved: Query Qualified and Requirement Gathering Started

\-\> Closed: Query Converted into an Active Opportunity

## Reverse Flow

BD Clarification Request Created

\-\> Assigned to Client

\-\> Acknowledged by Client

\-\> In Progress: Client Reviews Questions

\-\> Waiting for Information: Additional Context Required

\-\> Responded: Client Sends Clarification

\-\> Resolved: BD Updates Query Record

\-\> Closed

## Escalation Flow

No BD Action Within SLA

\-\> Overdue

\-\> Escalated to Human BD or BD Manager

\-\> Resolved / Reassigned / Rejected

\-\> Closed  
![][image1]

# 2\. BD to PM Handover Workflow

## Forward Flow

Requirement Handover Created

\-\> Assigned to PM Agent

\-\> Acknowledged by PM Agent

\-\> In Progress: Requirement Brief Reviewed

\-\> Waiting for Information: Missing or Unclear Details Identified

\-\> Responded: BD Provides Additional Information

\-\> Resolved: PM Accepts the Handover

\-\> Closed

## Reverse Flow

PM Clarification Request Created

\-\> Assigned to BD Agent

\-\> Acknowledged by BD Agent

\-\> In Progress: BD Reviews Missing Information

\-\> Waiting for Information: Client Input Required

\-\> Responded: BD Provides Clarification

\-\> Resolved: PM Updates the Project Record

\-\> Closed

## Escalation Flow

Handover Not Accepted Within SLA

\-\> Overdue

\-\> Escalated to Human PM and Human BD

\-\> Resolved / Reassigned / Rejected

\-\> Closed

![][image2]

# 3\. PM Clarification Back to BD Workflow

## Forward Flow

Clarification Request Created

\-\> Assigned to BD Agent

\-\> Acknowledged by BD Agent

\-\> In Progress: Questions Reviewed

\-\> Waiting for Information: Client Response Required

\-\> Responded: BD Provides Client Clarification

\-\> Resolved: PM Confirms Requirements

\-\> Closed

## Reverse Flow

Clarification Response Created

\-\> Assigned to PM Agent

\-\> Acknowledged by PM Agent

\-\> In Progress: Response Validated

\-\> Waiting for Information: Further Detail Required

\-\> Responded: BD Supplies Additional Detail

\-\> Resolved: Requirement Record Updated

\-\> Closed

## Escalation Flow

Client or BD Response Delayed

\-\> Overdue

\-\> Escalated to Human BD and Human PM

\-\> Resolved / Rejected / Project Put On Hold

\-\> Closed

![][image3]

# 4\. PM to TL Handover Workflow

## Forward Flow

Technical Handover Created

\-\> Assigned to TL Agent

\-\> Acknowledged by TL Agent

\-\> In Progress: SRS, Scope, and Phases Reviewed

\-\> Waiting for Information: Technical Clarification Requested

\-\> Responded: PM Provides Clarification

\-\> Resolved: TL Accepts Technical Ownership

\-\> Closed

## Reverse Flow

Technical Question Created

\-\> Assigned to PM Agent

\-\> Acknowledged by PM Agent

\-\> In Progress: Scope and Requirement Reviewed

\-\> Waiting for Information: BD or Client Input Required

\-\> Responded: PM Sends Approved Clarification

\-\> Resolved: TL Updates Technical Plan

\-\> Closed

## Escalation Flow

Technical Handover Blocked

\-\> Overdue

\-\> Escalated to Human TL and Human PM

\-\> Resolved / Reassigned / Rejected

\-\> Closed

![][image4]

# 5\. TL to Development Team Assignment Workflow

## Forward Flow

Development Assignment Created

\-\> Assigned to Developer, Designer, QA, or DevOps

\-\> Acknowledged by Assigned Team Member

\-\> In Progress: Work Started

\-\> Waiting for Information: Clarification or Dependency Required

\-\> Responded: TL Provides Guidance or Reassignment

\-\> Resolved: Work Ownership Confirmed

\-\> Closed

## Reverse Flow

Team Question or Update Created

\-\> Assigned to TL Agent

\-\> Acknowledged by TL Agent

\-\> In Progress: Request Reviewed

\-\> Waiting for Information: PM or Other Team Input Required

\-\> Responded: TL Provides Guidance

\-\> Resolved: Ticket Updated

\-\> Closed

## Escalation Flow

Assignment Not Acknowledged Within SLA

\-\> Overdue

\-\> Escalated to Human TL

\-\> Resolved / Reassigned / Rejected

\-\> Closed

![][image5]

# 6\. Developer Blocker Escalation Workflow

## Forward Flow

Blocker Created

\-\> Assigned to TL Agent

\-\> Acknowledged by TL Agent

\-\> In Progress: Blocker Investigated

\-\> Waiting for Information: PM, Client, DevOps, or Design Input Required

\-\> Responded: Required Guidance or Access Provided

\-\> Resolved: Blocker Removed

\-\> Closed

## Reverse Flow

Resolution Update Created

\-\> Assigned to Developer

\-\> Acknowledged by Developer

\-\> In Progress: Fix or Workaround Applied

\-\> Waiting for Information: Additional Support Required

\-\> Responded: Developer Confirms Outcome

\-\> Resolved: Ticket Work Resumed

\-\> Closed

## Escalation Flow

Blocker Not Resolved Within SLA

\-\> Overdue

\-\> Escalated to Human TL and PM

\-\> Resolved / Reassigned / Rejected

\-\> Closed

![][image6]

# 7\. Development to QA Workflow

## Forward Flow

QA Submission Created

\-\> Assigned to QA Agent

\-\> Acknowledged by QA Agent

\-\> In Progress: Build and Ticket Reviewed

\-\> Waiting for Information: Missing Build, Test Data, or Acceptance Criteria

\-\> Responded: Developer or TL Provides Required Information

\-\> Resolved: QA Testing Started or Completed

\-\> Closed

## Reverse Flow

QA Feedback Created

\-\> Assigned to Developer

\-\> Acknowledged by Developer

\-\> In Progress: Fix or Clarification Prepared

\-\> Waiting for Information: QA Detail Required

\-\> Responded: QA Provides Additional Evidence

\-\> Resolved: Developer Resubmits the Work

\-\> Closed

## Escalation Flow

QA Cannot Start Within SLA

\-\> Overdue

\-\> Escalated to QA Lead and TL

\-\> Resolved / Reassigned / Rejected

\-\> Closed

![][image7]

# 8\. QA Bug Reporting and Retesting Workflow

## Forward Flow

Bug Created

\-\> Assigned to Developer

\-\> Acknowledged by Developer

\-\> In Progress: Bug Investigated and Fixed

\-\> Waiting for Information: Reproduction Detail or Technical Input Required

\-\> Responded: QA or TL Provides Clarification

\-\> Resolved: Fix Submitted for Retesting

\-\> Closed After QA Pass

## Reverse Flow

Retest Request Created

\-\> Assigned to QA Agent

\-\> Acknowledged by QA Agent

\-\> In Progress: Bug Retested

\-\> Waiting for Information: New Build or Test Data Required

\-\> Responded: Developer Provides Updated Build

\-\> Resolved: Bug Passed or Reopened

\-\> Closed

## Rejection Loop

QA Retest Failed

\-\> Rejected

\-\> Reassigned to Developer

\-\> Acknowledged

\-\> In Progress

\-\> Resolved

\-\> Returned to QA

## Escalation Flow

Critical Bug or Repeated Failure

\-\> Overdue

\-\> Escalated to Human TL, QA Lead, and PM

\-\> Resolved / Release Rejected / Reassigned

\-\> Closed

![][image8]

# 9\. PM Progress Reporting to BD Workflow

## Forward Flow

Progress Report Created

\-\> Assigned to BD Agent

\-\> Acknowledged by BD Agent

\-\> In Progress: Report Reviewed for Client Communication

\-\> Waiting for Information: Missing Progress, Risk, or Timeline Detail

\-\> Responded: PM Provides Additional Information

\-\> Resolved: Client Update Approved

\-\> Closed

## Reverse Flow

BD Feedback Created

\-\> Assigned to PM Agent

\-\> Acknowledged by PM Agent

\-\> In Progress: Feedback Reviewed

\-\> Waiting for Information: TL or Team Input Required

\-\> Responded: PM Updates the Report

\-\> Resolved: Final Update Returned to BD

\-\> Closed

## Escalation Flow

Progress Report Delayed

\-\> Overdue

\-\> Escalated to Human PM and Human BD

\-\> Resolved / Reassigned / Rejected

\-\> Closed

![][image9]

# 10\. BD Update to Client Workflow

## Forward Flow

Client Update Created

\-\> Assigned to Client

\-\> Acknowledged by Client

\-\> In Progress: Client Reviews the Update

\-\> Waiting for Information: Client Feedback or Decision Required

\-\> Responded: Client Provides Feedback

\-\> Resolved: BD Records the Client Response

\-\> Closed

## Reverse Flow

Client Question Created

\-\> Assigned to BD Agent

\-\> Acknowledged by BD Agent

\-\> In Progress: Question Reviewed

\-\> Waiting for Information: PM or TL Input Required

\-\> Responded: BD Sends Approved Answer

\-\> Resolved: Client Confirms Understanding

\-\> Closed

## Escalation Flow

Client Decision or Response Delayed

\-\> Overdue

\-\> Escalated to Human BD

\-\> Resolved / Project Put On Hold / Rejected

\-\> Closed

![][image10]

# 11\. Change Request Workflow

## Forward Flow

Change Request Created

\-\> Assigned to PM Agent

\-\> Acknowledged by PM Agent

\-\> In Progress: Business and Project Impact Assessed

\-\> Assigned to TL for Technical Analysis

\-\> Acknowledged by TL

\-\> In Progress: Effort, Risk, and Dependency Analysis

\-\> Waiting for Information: Client, BD, QA, Design, or Development Input Required

\-\> Responded: Required Impact Details Provided

\-\> Assigned for Human and Client Approval

\-\> Approved or Rejected

\-\> Resolved: Scope, SRS, Timeline, and Tickets Updated

\-\> Closed

## Reverse Flow

Clarification or Approval Request Created

\-\> Assigned to Requester or Approver

\-\> Acknowledged

\-\> In Progress: Request Reviewed

\-\> Waiting for Information: Additional Details Required

\-\> Responded: Clarification or Decision Provided

\-\> Resolved: PM Updates Change Request

\-\> Closed

## Approved Change Flow

Approved

\-\> Updated Requirements

\-\> Updated SRS

\-\> Updated Project Plan

\-\> Tickets Created or Modified

\-\> Assigned

\-\> Development

\-\> QA

\-\> Deployment

\-\> Closed

## Rejected Change Flow

Change Request Reviewed

\-\> Rejected

\-\> Rejection Reason Recorded

\-\> Client or Requester Notified

\-\> Closed

## Escalation Flow

Change Decision Delayed

\-\> Overdue

\-\> Escalated to Human PM, TL, BD, and Management

\-\> Approved / Rejected / Put On Hold

\-\> Closed

![][image11]

# 12\. Deployment and Approval Workflow

## Forward Flow

Deployment Request Created

\-\> Assigned to DevOps Agent

\-\> Acknowledged by DevOps

\-\> In Progress: Release Package and Checklist Validated

\-\> Waiting for Information: QA Sign-Off, Backup, Migration, or Approval Required

\-\> Responded: Required Approval or Information Provided

\-\> Assigned for Human Release Approval

\-\> Approved or Rejected

\-\> In Progress: Deployment Executed

\-\> Resolved: Smoke Tests Passed and Release Verified

\-\> Closed

## Reverse Flow

Deployment Issue or Rollback Request Created

\-\> Assigned to TL and DevOps

\-\> Acknowledged

\-\> In Progress: Incident Investigated

\-\> Waiting for Information: PM, QA, or Infrastructure Decision Required

\-\> Responded: Rollback or Fix Approved

\-\> Resolved: Service Restored or Deployment Corrected

\-\> Closed

## Approval Flow

Release Ready

\-\> QA Approval

\-\> TL Approval

\-\> PM or Release Manager Approval

\-\> Client Approval When Required

\-\> Deployment Authorized

## Rejection Flow

Approval Review

\-\> Rejected

\-\> Rejection Reason Recorded

\-\> Returned to Development, QA, or DevOps

\-\> Corrective Work Completed

\-\> Resubmitted for Approval

## Escalation Flow

Deployment Failure or Production Risk

\-\> Overdue / Critical

\-\> Escalated to Human DevOps Lead, TL, PM, and Management

\-\> Rollback / Fix / Release Rejected

\-\> Resolved

\-\> Closed

![][image12]

# Common Status Definitions

| Status | Definition |
| :---- | :---- |
| Created | A new task, request, follow-up, approval, bug, or handover has been recorded. |
| Assigned | A responsible agent or human owner has been selected. |
| Acknowledged | The assigned owner has confirmed receipt and ownership. |
| In Progress | The assigned owner is actively working on the item. |
| Waiting for Information | Work is paused because clarification, access, approval, or another dependency is required. |
| Responded | The requested information, decision, or feedback has been provided. |
| Resolved | The required action has been completed successfully. |
| Overdue | The item has exceeded its configured deadline or SLA. |
| Escalated | The item has been sent to a higher authority because it remains unresolved or is high risk. |
| Rejected | The request, submission, change, approval, fix, or release has not been accepted. |
| Closed | All required actions and records are complete, and no further work is pending. |

# Workflow Governance Rules

1. Every workflow must start with `Created`.  
2. Every item must have a clearly identified owner after `Assigned`.  
3. The assigned owner must explicitly acknowledge the item.  
4. Items cannot remain in `Waiting for Information` without a responsible responder and deadline.  
5. `Overdue` must be triggered automatically when the SLA expires.  
6. `Escalated` must identify the escalation level and responsible human owner.  
7. `Rejected` must always include a reason and corrective next step.  
8. `Resolved` requires completion evidence.  
9. `Closed` requires final verification and completed audit records.  
10. All transitions must be recorded in the audit log.
